{{Top}}
'''Snails''' were shelled mollusks found on many worlds, including [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. They were well known for being slow, inspiring the expression "a snail's pace," meaning that a particular objective was taking too long to accomplish.

[[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|Corporate Alliance tank droids]] were likened to snails.
